# laravelforge_site_application_log (Data Source)

Fetches the application log content for a Laravel Forge site.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The content of the application log.
